name: better-tray-icons
description: A GNOME Shell extension that brings tray icons back to the top panel.

scripts.test: npm run test:schema && npm run test:po && npm run lint
scripts.test:po: for po in po/*.po; do [ -e "$po" ] || continue; msgfmt -c -o /dev/null "$po" || exit 1; done
scripts.compile-locales: mkdir -p locale && for po in po/*.po; do lang=$(basename "$po" .po); mkdir -p locale/$lang/LC_MESSAGES; msgfmt "$po" -o locale/$lang/LC_MESSAGES/bettertrayicons.mo; done
